name: g1
_note: G1 deterministic SQUAT: hold the proven arms-down stand, then on top of it blend the legs DEEPER into a knee-bend (a quasi-static squat), hold at the bottom, and rise back -- repeated `reps` times. Same controller/stiffness as the stand; the squat is a feedforward time-varying leg target (see the `squat` block) and the existing reactive lean + arm_balance + hip auto_trim keep the CoM centred through the transient. Base pose/balance copied verbatim from g1_armsdown.json (the robust cube-defense stand).

squat._note: Quasi-static squat overlay on the legs. Phases: WAIT(start_s) -> DESCEND(descend_s, smoothstep) -> HOLD(hold_s) -> RISE(rise_s) -> BETWEEN(between_s), repeated `reps` times, then DONE (hold the stand). `delta` are per-joint OFFSETS from the standing nominal at the bottom of the squat; ankle delta = -(hip+knee) keeps the foot FLAT. ff_ank/ff_hip add an OPEN-LOOP depth-proportional lean-back (like the manip CoM-back) -- start at 0 and only raise if it tips forward. bz_drop is how far the pelvis is EXPECTED to sink at the bottom (m): the fall check lowers bz_min by frac*bz_drop so a deliberate crouch is not mis-flagged as a fall.

lean._note: Reactive fore/aft ankle lean -- holds the marginal G1 CoM through the squat transient.

arm_balance._note: Arms are the fast dynamic balancer through the squat (shoulder_pitch swings back on forward lean). kd=0.

auto_trim._note: HIP-ONLY slow return-to-home integral; mops up residual CoM creep across the squat reps.
